# ESXi Bulk VM Termination

**Type:** TTP

**Author:** Raven Tait, Splunk

**Upstream version:** 1

## Description

This detection identifies when all virtual machines on an ESXi host are abruptly terminated, which may indicate malicious activity such as a deliberate denial-of-service, ransomware staging, or an attempt to destroy critical workloads.

## MITRE ATT&CK

| ID | Technique | Tactics |
|---|---|---|
| [T1673](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1673/) | Virtual Machine Discovery | discovery |
| [T1529](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1529/) | System Shutdown/Reboot | impact |
| [T1499](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1499/) | Endpoint Denial of Service | impact |

## Analytic Stories

- ESXi Post Compromise
- Black Basta Ransomware

## Data Sources

- VMWare ESXi Syslog
